pr.body:
Closes #7471
Scenarios: U7471a
A Pane's views reach the Toast queue through a per-Project queue (`projectMessageQueue`, `ink/messageToast.tsx`); `createMessageToast` reads its origin once per message, so a hidden Project's toast starts with `<name> · ` and keeps its text after a tab switch. No call site writes the prefix; App-level and Rail toasts are unchanged.

Reuse: no new library machinery; it is a thin wrapper over the existing `ToastQueueContext` (Solid context already installed), so no candidates apply.

Moves: none (copy only, no layout change).
